semantic_hash: SHA-256 over fixed-order logical columns, explicit little-endian scalar encodings, and path-free semantic config
notes: The builder emits the complete machine-readable schema.json beside every dataset.
Exact Delta vectors are reconstructed from frozen base vectors and are not duplicated in the dataset.
neighbor_slot=-1 means that the native frozen index was unavailable and adjacency was not validated.
Label-only columns must never be supplied to the online estimator.
